text:
Trevor Connelly is the rookie Vegas can't stop talking about. The 20-year-old from Tustin, California has seven goals and 12 points in 19 games, and he's done it with flair: a breakaway where he slammed on the brakes and went around Arturs Silovs, a bank shot from the goal line, a late winner in Detroit. SinBin.vegas ran the headline "It's Time To Give Trevor Connelly A Bigger Role," and the numbers back that up. Vegas has 60.9% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, more than 10 points better than without him.

Some of the goals will cool off. He's shooting 20.6% against a league norm of about 13%, and our wins-added numbers rank him 21st in the league, partly on timing. But his own chances, about a goal per 60, are real, and his skating is elite: his top speed sits in the 99th percentile.

He's still only playing 14 minutes a night. Our range puts him around 23 goals and 49 points with room above if he gets the bigger role.
headline: Trevor Connelly is making Vegas find him minutes
